product.schneider-d48620-420.summary: The /20–420 designation in the Portuguese IFS advertisement for the Business range.
product.schneider-d48620-420.history: Schneider introduced the D486/20 in November 1991 as its Business-line 486SX, with 8 MB as standard. The December German list quoted DM 5,289 net for the basic configuration. In May 1992, IFS advertised the /20–420 designation in Portugal.
product.schneider-d48620-420.technical.c: Offers varied by market and date. The 1991 German list shows 100 and 200 MB disks for the D486/20. The Portuguese advertisement identifies the /20–420 designation. The corresponding drive still needs verification. The service manual also lists SD, HD 120 and HD 200.
product.schneider-d48620-420.technical.b: A surviving unit identifies its board. The photographs show Schneider Singleboard II 486, assembly 54 091, and the Intel 82346A controller. The owner documents 4 MB and a 213 MB Maxtor. Computerwoche reported 8 MB as standard.
product.schneider-d48620-420.technical.f: Boot screens identify the firmware of that specimen. They show Quadtel 3.05.06, Schneider 1.00a and VGA 3.04. The commercial revision and dumps remain pending. The manual documents the system and VGA ROM at U16, part 53 891 00. The schematic allows 27C010/20/40 and the parts list specifies 128 KiB.
product.schneider-d48620-420.technical.v: BluMach has the documentary sheet. A dedicated model and boot remain pending.
product.schneider-d48620-420.technical.l: ROM preservation, comparison of physical configurations and board validation remain pending. The sheet awaits an image with clear publication rights.
